ranking_note: Authored from the before descriptions at commit 839154fe6e924a88a0308868acca701920c4e1a2, frozen before the rewrite; protocol per /playbooks:skill-authoring ## Measurement. Competitors are the plugin-quality setup and report skills (same-plugin near-misses) plus the skills the audit description names or borders on: static skill QA (skill-quality:check), MCP tool audits (mcp-tools:audit), PR code review (review:code-review), the installed-plugin landscape report (harness-ops:audit-plugin-landscape), and bug write-ups (bugs:write).
